questions.label: Does the visited plot match the supplied location and description?
questions.detail: GPS, landmarks and overview photos; explain location uncertainty.

questions.label: What visible boundary features can you identify?
questions.detail: Label fencing, markers or edges by viewpoint. Attribute features pointed out by a contact; record sides not identifiable.

questions.label: How is the plot accessed?
questions.detail: Approach route, entrance, visible route condition and obstructions.

questions.label: What is on the plot and how is it being used?
questions.detail: Structures, vegetation, cultivation, visible signs of occupation and activity; avoid identifying occupants.
questions.evidence_prompt: Attach overview photos and a short video showing the plot's current use, structures, vegetation and visible activity. If the request concerns an empty plot, show its visible condition.

questions.label: What other visible conditions affect the client's question?
questions.detail: Standing water, dumping, slope or activity near indicated edges. Locate each concern; describe possible encroachment signs without a legal conclusion.

questions.label: Does the property match the reference information?
questions.detail: Exterior, entrance, address and identifying features.
questions.evidence_prompt: Attach exterior and entrance photos and a short overview video showing the property and its identifying features.

questions.label: What is the visible exterior and compound condition?
questions.detail: Wide views and close-ups of damage or unfinished work.

questions.label: What interior areas were inspected and what was observed?
questions.detail: Room-by-room permitted photos; mark inaccessible rooms.

questions.label: What visible signs of occupation or use are present?
questions.detail: Observed use and separately attributed contact explanations; no monitoring individuals.

questions.label: Are the requested rooms fittings utilities and features present?
questions.detail: Repeat for each feature. Record present / absent / not seen, and whether operation was demonstrated or only reported.

questions.label: What is the status of each agreed milestone?
questions.detail: Repeat per item: complete / partial / not started / unable to assess, with labelled photos.
questions.evidence_prompt: Attach labelled photos and a short video showing the agreed work items and their visible stage of completion.

questions.label: What changed since the reference report?
questions.detail: Reference date and comparable views; if none, describe current condition.

questions.label: What unfinished work damage or apparent defects are visible?
questions.detail: Location, overview and close-up photos; no technical diagnosis.

questions.label: What activity materials and equipment were visible?
questions.detail: Record the visit time and observed work. Counts only where feasible and agreed.

questions.label: What did the site representative say about delays and next steps?
questions.detail: Role, attributed explanation, dates stated, and which claims were independently observed.

questions.label: Is the business present at the stated location?
questions.detail: Frontage, name, signage, address and matching features.
questions.evidence_prompt: Attach frontage and signage photos and a short video showing the business premises and visible operating status at the visit time.

questions.label: Was it open and operating at the visit time?
questions.detail: Time, observed activity and permitted photos. If closed, record posted hours or attributed explanation.

questions.label: Were the requested goods stock or services available?
questions.detail: Item list, photos and count only where agreed and feasible; distinguish observed stock from reported availability.

questions.label: What is the visible condition of premises stock and equipment?
questions.detail: Wide views and close-ups relevant to the brief.

questions.label: What additional brief details could a representative confirm?
questions.detail: Role, specific answers and permitted records. Identify unverified claims.

questions.label: Does the vehicle match the supplied description?
questions.detail: Make, model, colour and registration; front, rear, side and plate photos where permitted.
questions.evidence_prompt: Attach front, rear and side photos and a short overview video showing the vehicle and relevant identifying features.

questions.label: Do accessible identification markings match?
questions.detail: VIN or chassis reference and permitted photo; explain inaccessible or unclear markings.

questions.label: What is the visible exterior condition?
questions.detail: Bodywork, glass, lights, tyres, damage and missing parts; label locations.

questions.label: What is the visible interior and dashboard condition?
questions.detail: Interior, displayed mileage and units, warning indicators, ignition or engine state. Displayed mileage is not verified history.

questions.label: Which agreed functions were demonstrated?
questions.detail: Function-by-function observed result and permitted video; separate contact claims and checks not performed.

questions.label: Which requested assets are physically present?
questions.detail: Repeat by item: description, expected and observed quantity, location and overview photo.
questions.evidence_prompt: Attach photos and a short video showing the requested assets, quantities where feasible, and visible identifying features.

questions.label: Do identifiers match the supplied references?
questions.detail: Make, model, serial or asset tag; permitted identifier photo and any mismatch.

questions.label: What is each asset's visible condition?
questions.detail: Damage, missing parts, packaging and signs of use; close-ups.

questions.label: Which agreed functions were demonstrated?
questions.detail: Observed operation, demonstration provider and permitted video. Mark not tested where applicable.

questions.label: How do findings compare with the funded purchase list?
questions.detail: Match each line to evidence; record absent, substituted or inaccessible items without inferring misuse.

questions.label: Are the required consent and institutional access in place?
questions.detail: Consent reference, scope, date and cooperating office; if absent stop the personal check and record the limit.

questions.label: What enrolment claim is being checked?
questions.detail: Minimum necessary student reference, programme and semester supplied by the client.

questions.label: What could the authorised office confirm?
questions.detail: Confirmed / contradicted / declined / no record located, exact period and office role; do not infer non-enrolment from non-response.
questions.evidence_prompt: Attach permitted photos and a short video documenting the institutional location or confirmation process, without recording private student records or people without permission. State what the media actually supports; location evidence alone does not confirm enrolment.

questions.label: Does the permitted confirmation match the reference?
questions.detail: Programme, semester and status differences; written record only if permitted.

questions.label: What remains unresolved?
questions.detail: Missing period, restricted detail or follow-up channel. No class attendance conclusion.

questions.label: What payment is in scope and is access authorised?
questions.detail: Consent reference, university office, receipt or transaction reference and agreed period.

questions.label: What details appear on the supplied payment reference?
questions.detail: Date, amount, currency, payee and minimum necessary student reference.

questions.label: What did the authorised office confirm about that payment?
questions.detail: Record match, amount, date and account allocation if permitted; office role and response date.
questions.evidence_prompt: Attach permitted photos and a short video documenting the payment confirmation visit or process. Show a redacted confirmation only where permitted. Location footage alone does not confirm payment.

questions.label: Are there discrepancies or limits?
questions.detail: Unmatched reference, different amount or allocation, pending processing, refusal or insufficient information.

questions.label: What permitted confirmation can support the report?
questions.detail: Evidence ID or attributed confirmation. No conclusion on full fee clearance unless specifically confirmed within scope.

questions.label: Is consent and institutional cooperation documented?
questions.detail: Consent reference, permitted office and disclosure scope; stop if required authorisation is absent.

questions.label: What attendance period and activity are being checked?
questions.detail: Exact dates, programme, classes or institutional attendance definition.

questions.label: What attendance information could the institution confirm?
questions.detail: Permitted summary, period covered, source office and date. Distinguish a record from a verbal statement.
questions.evidence_prompt: Attach permitted photos and a short video documenting the institution or authorised confirmation process. Do not film students to establish attendance. Context footage alone does not confirm attendance records.

questions.label: How does that information compare with the client's question?
questions.detail: Only report the period and activities actually covered; explain gaps.

questions.label: What could not be established?
questions.detail: Unavailable records, disclosure limits or non-response and permitted follow-up. No surveillance or student tracking.

questions.label: Are authorisation and facility agreement in place?
questions.detail: Consent reference, permitted disclosure and authorised office. Stop the personal check if requirements are unmet.

questions.label: Which specific visit or receipt is being checked?
questions.detail: Agreed facility, date or date range and minimum necessary reference; exclude medical history.

questions.label: What could the authorised facility confirm?
questions.detail: Visit or receipt match, source role and response date. Refusal or no record located is not proof that no visit occurred.
questions.evidence_prompt: Attach permitted exterior or administrative-area photos and a short video documenting the facility visit. Do not record patients or confidential records. This media supports visit context; the agreed visit claim requires the facility confirmation recorded in your answer.

questions.label: Does the confirmation match the supplied details?
questions.detail: Only agreed administrative fields; identify differences without medical interpretation.

questions.label: What evidence and limitations can be reported?
questions.detail: Permitted confirmation ID or attributed statement. Explain missing access; exclude incidental health information.

questions.label: What document and claim are in scope?
questions.detail: Document type, issuer, reference and fields to compare; consent and access basis.

questions.label: What agreed fields are visible on the document?
questions.detail: Record only necessary fields; redacted image if permitted. Identify whether original, copy or screen image was shown.

questions.label: Do the visible fields match the supplied reference?
questions.detail: Field-by-field match or discrepancy; unreadable fields marked unable to compare.
questions.evidence_prompt: Attach permitted photos and a short video showing the agreed document fields or comparison process, with unrelated personal details concealed. If recording the document is not permitted, explain the limitation; context footage alone does not establish a field match.

questions.label: What could a cooperating issuer confirm?
questions.detail: Authorised channel, role, date and exact scope of confirmation; refusal or no response recorded separately.

questions.label: What conclusion is supported and what remains uncertain?
questions.detail: Separate visual comparison from issuer confirmation. Do not label the document authentic or fraudulent.

questions.label: Which receipt and transaction details are being checked?
questions.detail: Issuer, reference, date, amount, currency and agreed items; permissions as needed.

questions.label: What details are visible on the supplied receipt?
questions.detail: Readable fields, copy type and permitted redacted image.

questions.label: Does a cooperating issuer find a matching record?
questions.detail: Source role and channel; record match / discrepancy / no record located / declined / no response.
questions.evidence_prompt: Attach permitted photos and a short video showing the relevant redacted receipt or issuer confirmation process. If only location footage is permitted, describe its limited purpose; record confirmation separately in your answer.

questions.label: Which transaction fields match or differ?
questions.detail: Compare each agreed field; report refunds or cancellation only if specifically checked and confirmed.

questions.label: What evidence supports the result and what is unresolved?
questions.detail: Permitted record or attributed confirmation and follow-up. No authenticity guarantee.

questions.label: Is this the agreed delivery location and reference order?
questions.detail: Location evidence, order reference and agreed delivery date.

questions.label: Which ordered items are physically present?
questions.detail: Repeat each line: description, expected and observed quantities, make or identifier where relevant.
questions.evidence_prompt: Attach photos and a short video showing the delivered items, quantities and relevant identifiers against the supplied order.

questions.label: What is the visible condition of items and packaging?
questions.detail: Overview and close-ups of damage, missing parts or seals; state whether unpacking was permitted.

questions.label: What matches or differs from the order?
questions.detail: Missing, substituted or inaccessible items. Separate counted quantities from contact-reported quantities.

questions.label: What delivery details or demonstrations were confirmed?
questions.detail: Contact role, permitted delivery note, delivery date as reported, and any agreed function observed; mark untested.

questions.label: Does the site match the agreed location and description?
questions.detail: Address, landmarks and permitted overview.

questions.label: What access and facilities relevant to the brief were observed?
questions.detail: Entrance, parking, rooms or available space; dimensions only if measured within scope.

questions.label: What is the visible condition of the requested areas?
questions.detail: Labelled wide views and close-ups.
questions.evidence_prompt: Attach photos and a short video showing the requested site areas and the conditions relevant to the client's questions.

questions.label: What did the authorised contact confirm?
questions.detail: Role, exact statement and supporting permitted record; separate observation from claims.

questions.label: What is the answer to each custom client question?
questions.detail: Repeat per question with evidence ID, discrepancy and limitation. Reject additions outside the agreed scope.

questions.label: Is this an eligible merchant and did they agree to participate?
questions.detail: Merchant code, location, eligibility, respondent role and consent. Record declined or ineligible without pressure; recording consent separately.

questions.label: What is the business profile?
questions.detail: Agreed category, approximate operating history, opening pattern and customer type; distinguish observed from reported.

questions.label: What products services and payment methods are offered?
questions.detail: Approved categories and current availability; mark observed / respondent-reported. Allow do not know and prefer not to answer.
questions.evidence_prompt: Attach permitted photos and a short video showing the relevant storefront, products or payment facilities. Do not record the interview or respondent without separate permission. Label which findings were observed and which were reported.

questions.label: What are the merchant's experiences needs and challenges?
questions.detail: Ask neutrally: What works well? What difficulties arise? What would help? Record answers in their own words; no sensitive financial detail unless explicitly in scope and voluntary.

questions.label: What additional approved survey items and observations apply?
questions.detail: Insert the exact client-approved wording and response choices before dispatch. Record interview date, completion status, skipped items and reasons; no invented responses.
